name: Split Flap
description: The frame becomes a split-flap board: in each cell the top half of the first clip flips down on a hinge across the middle, cell after cell, its back bringing the bottom half of the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: stagger
params.description: Delay of the last cell's flip, as a part of the transition

params.name: randomness
params.description: How much the order of the cells is shuffled, from a wave across the board to random

params.name: flaps
params.description: Number of flaps that fall in each cell, the ones before the last showing other parts of the second clip

params.name: gap
params.description: Width of the gaps between the cells, as a part of the frame's shorter side

params.name: perspective
params.description: Amount of perspective: the falling flaps grow as they come toward the viewer

params.name: shading
params.description: How much the flaps darken as they turn away from the light, and their shadows

params.name: background
params.description: Color seen in the gaps between the cells
